title: finding(plugin-list): a `chart` list view bound to a semantic `dataset` gets a node with no filter, so neither the authored view filter nor the toolbar Filter reaches its query
body:
Ruled: 5825582592 · letter A (refuse view filter on dataset chart; withhold toolbar Filter) · 2026-09-25T02:18Z

Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. The site: the `chart` branch of `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` for the dataset binding shape (`resolveListChartBinding` shape `'dataset'`, ADR-0021), and `ObjectChart`'s `queryDataset` call in `packages/plugin-charts`.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10250 (PR objectui#10323). The dev measured it; ⛔ it is filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

A `chart` list view bound to a semantic **dataset** gets an `object-chart` node carrying **no `filter`** at all. Two filters are lost:

- the view's own **authored** filter, which the list view declares and an author expects to scope the chart;
- the toolbar **Filter and chips**.

`ObjectChart` calls `queryDataset` with only the dimensions and measures. objectui#10250 (PR objectui#10323) forwards the effective filter to the OBJECT-bound chart only. This shape was left out on purpose, because it is not a one-line forwarding. `queryDataset`'s `runtimeFilter` is the spec's `FilterCondition`, and a dataset's field namespace need not be the list object's. Mapping list-object fields onto dataset dimensions is a real design step.

## Reproduction (the dev's real-renderer probe, on `main` `8b1f06619` and on PR head `3bd041e6a`, not committed)

- The view has authored filter `[[name,!=,zzz]]` and toolbar `status = open` is active. `queryDataset` is called as `["task_ds", { "dimensions": ["status"], "measures": ["total_estimate"] }]`, with no `runtimeFilter`.
- ⚠️ These readings are the dev's, relayed by the seat, ⛔ not re-run by the seat.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The authored-filter half is the more serious one. An author's declared scope is silently dropped on this binding shape, so the chart shows unfiltered totals.
- Fix direction is open: translate the list filter into the dataset's `runtimeFilter` (needs a field-namespace mapping), or refuse a list-view filter on a dataset-bound chart at authoring time. That may be a decision.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `queryDataset … (runtimeFilter|filter)` / `dataset … chart … filter … (drop|lost|never|ignor|not)` / `runtimeFilter … ListView` ⇒ 0 hits. Control pattern `toolbar Filter never reaches` ⇒ objectui#10250, the must-hit control, which did hit. ⇒ No duplicate.

Dedupe words: `dataset chart list view filter` · `queryDataset runtimeFilter ListView` · `chart dataset authored filter dropped` · `resolveListChartBinding dataset filter`
